About us

The UiPath Platform™ accelerates the shift toward a new era of agentic automation—one where agents, robots, people, and models integrate seamlessly to drive autonomy and smarter decision-making. With a focus on security, accuracy, and resiliency, UiPath is committed to shaping a world where AI enhances human potential and revolutionizes industries.

When release cycles accelerate, standard QA methods quickly become major bottlenecks, forcing teams to compromise between speed and software quality.

It’s time to turn software testing from a delayed sign-off into your biggest strategic advantage. ⚡

Here is how modern engineering teams are revolutionizing quality across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC) with UiPath:

🤖 Orchestrate Intelligent Workflows with Agent Builder & Maestro™ Move beyond basic scripts to intelligent AI agents. Build custom agents to orchestrate end-to-end quality workflows, scaling agentic automation while improving governance and delivering faster, more reliable releases.

⚡ Accelerate Design & Execution with Test Manager & Test Studio Put AI directly to work in test design, automation, and execution. Dramatically cut manual effort, boost test coverage, and streamline quality engineering from start to finish.

☁️ Scale Release Confidence with UiPath Test Cloud Break through traditional bottlenecks with AI-powered cloud testing. Ship software faster while increasing overall quality and release confidence.

Software quality isn't just about finding bugs before launch, it’s about building a continuous innovation engine. 🚀

How much business capacity is your organization consuming every year just to validate software changes?

Every major application change triggers a familiar pattern: Finance checks invoices, HR validates employee workflows, Procurement tests purchasing scenarios, Operations verifies critical processes.
None of these people are part of the testing organization. Yet collectively, they often represent the largest and most expensive testing workforce in the enterprise.

As transformation programs accelerate and AI becomes embedded into more business processes, asking domain experts to manually validate every release simply doesn't scale.
The question isn't whether business users should be involved, they absolutely should.

How can we preserve their expertise while eliminating the repetitive work?

This is exactly why I believe Agentic Testing will fundamentally change enterprise software delivery, not by replacing business users, but by allowing them to focus on exceptions and business decisions instead of repetitive validation.

I recently explored this topic in more detail here:

The Path Forward is a UiPath podcast for leaders confronting one of the most important business questions of our time: how to turn AI momentum into something you can actually rely on.

As AI moves from experimentation into the center of enterprise strategy, organizations are being asked to rethink how work happens, how decisions are made, and how people and technology create value together. The podcast explores the questions defining enterprise AI today: where human judgment matters most, how leaders translate ambition into measurable outcomes, how industries will change, and what it takes to scale AI safely, openly, and accountably.

Through conversations with UiPath leaders, customers, and industry voices, The Path Forward brings a grounded perspective to a fast-moving moment. Each episode offers clarity on the choices, tensions, and opportunities leaders are facing as AI becomes a bigger part of how business gets done.
